title: Sharp Subordination Radii through Boundary Minimization
summary: Let $\varphi$ and $ψ$ be univalent functions in the unit disk $\mathbb D$ satisfying $\varphi(0)=ψ(0)=1$ and $\varphi\not\precψ$, and let $\mathcal P_{\varphi}$ denote the class of analytic functions $p$ in $\mathbb D$ such that $p\prec\varphi$. Under suitable analytic continuation, univalence, and boundary-behavior hypotheses on the branch of $\varphi^{-1}$ satisfying $\varphi^{-1}(1)=0$, we determine the sharp $\mathcal P_ψ$-radius of $\mathcal P_{\varphi}$ as \[ \mathcal R(\varphi,ψ) = \min_{|ζ|=1} \left| \varphi^{-1}\bigl(ψ(ζ)\bigr) \right|. \] For Ma--Minda functions satisfying these…
